description: Get full details for one direct bus service: all route stops with estimated arrival times, fare, operator contact, operator timetable or booking link, schedule (AM and PM runs) and the directbus.sg page URL. Accepts a service number (e.g. "776", "SKM1", "BA 2 (AM)") or a URL slug (e.g. "ba-2-am", "skm1", "776").
name: get_bus
title: Get bus details
